title: Ruleset manifest (ruleset.json)
description: The top-level manifest of a rulesets/<id>/ directory: identity, format version, and every property the ruleset's actors carry, each named in the table's words. See internal/rules/load.go for the authoritative loader; this document is the external contract for ruleset authors and is cross-checked against loader behavior by internal/rules/schema_test.go.

format_version.description: Only "3" is accepted by this loader. Any other value, a retired format's among them, is refused with what format "3" declares (docs/adr/012-the-rules-contract.md). See atom.schema.json for the atoms/*.json this format composes abilities from.

properties.description: Every property the ruleset's actors carry, in the order the ruleset declares them. A key is declared once, whatever its type.

key.description: What an expression reads: '@'+key for a number, '#'+key for a resource. Must match ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$, the expression grammar's IDENT charset (internal/rules/expr.go), not kebab-case, since a hyphenated key would lex as subtraction ("brawn-2" -> "brawn" - 2); must not be "caster" or "target". At most 128 bytes of UTF-8.

type.description: A number is one value on an actor's sheet; a resource is a current value under a maximum.

name.description: The property's display name: what the table calls it, shown wherever the window names it.

description.description: What the property means at the table, for a player and for the agent.

default_max_expr.description: A resource only. Optional expression (see internal/rules/expr.go grammar). Dice (NdM) are rejected at load time in v1: this expression is evaluated without recording its rolls, so a die here would draw from the Roller unrecorded.

when.description: Expression; non-zero result means the threshold is met. Dice (NdM) are rejected at load time in v1: a threshold 'when' is evaluated without recording its rolls, which would break the rolled-once-recorded-forever testimony contract (spec §2 decision 3).

apply_condition.description: A condition id declared under conditions/.

thresholds.description: A resource only: conditions that follow its value.
